# key scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:keyScheme`](gmeow-keyScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/keyScheme>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The scheme/format of a cryptographic key (one of the [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](../classes/gmeow-KeyScheme.md) individuals). Functional: a key has exactly one scheme — a key of a different scheme is a different key.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md) -> [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](../classes/gmeow-KeyScheme.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:keyScheme`](gmeow-keyScheme.md) from [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md) to [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](../classes/gmeow-KeyScheme.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name a key's format — OpenPGP, X.509, SSH, Nostr — by pointing it at a [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](../classes/gmeow-KeyScheme.md) individual so consumers can route or align it by scheme.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the signing algorithm (use the literal [`gmeow:keyAlgorithm`](gmeow-keyAlgorithm.md)) and avoid asserting two schemes on one key — it is functional, so a key in a different scheme is a different key.

### How to use

- Point the key at exactly one seeded [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](../classes/gmeow-KeyScheme.md) individual; carry the source-variable algorithm and material on their own non-functional literal properties.

### Examples

- ex:lillithKey [`gmeow:keyScheme`](gmeow-keyScheme.md) [`gmeow:keySchemePGP`](../individuals/gmeow-keySchemePGP.md).
